evals.name: als-auto-brightness
evals.prompt: my screen brightness doesn't adjust to the room lighting anymore, can you sort that out? explain what you'd check and do first, before changing anything
evals.expected_output: Recognizes omarchy-als owns auto-brightness on this machine; checks its status/config/autostart rather than proposing to install wluma/clight or write a new daemon
assertions: Identifies omarchy-als (the custom ALS daemon) by name as the owner of auto-brightness on this machine
Plan checks omarchy-als state first (e.g. `omarchy-als status`, whether the daemon process is running, its autostart entry in ~/.config/hypr/autostart.lua, or its paused/toggled state)
Does NOT propose installing a third-party auto-brightness tool (wluma, clight, brightnessd, iio-sensor-proxy-based solutions) or writing a new daemon as the fix
Does NOT propose writing brightness sysfs files directly as root / with sudo (writes should go through brightnessctl/logind or the daemon)

evals.name: static-wallpaper-over-aquarium
evals.prompt: i want a static mountain wallpaper instead of whatever animated thing is running on my desktop right now - how do i switch? walk me through it, don't change anything yet
evals.expected_output: Identifies the animated background as omarchy-aquarium on layer 1, says to toggle it off (SUPER+ALT+A / omarchy-aquarium-toggle), then use omarchy theme bg / user backgrounds directory
assertions: Correctly identifies the animated background as omarchy-aquarium (the custom GLSL layer-1 wallpaper), not as a stock Omarchy feature or an unknown process to kill
Tells the user to turn it off via its own toggle (SUPER+ALT+A keybinding or omarchy-aquarium-toggle), not by killing the process, removing its autostart, or uninstalling it

Explains the static wallpaper still goes through the normal Omarchy path (omarchy theme bg / backgrounds directory ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/<theme>/ or the theme's backgrounds dir) since the aquarium draws ABOVE the wallpaper layer
Does NOT propose editing files under /usr/share/omarchy/ or disabling the omarchy-background shell plugin

evals.name: battery-80-percent-cap
evals.prompt: why does my battery stop charging at 80%? i have a long trip tomorrow and need a full charge. tell me the plan before touching anything
evals.expected_output: Explains the deliberate 80% cap and points to omarchy-battery-limit toggle (travel mode until reboot; udev rule restores the cap), not editing udev rules or raw sysfs
assertions: Explains the 80% stop is a deliberate charge-limit setup on this machine (udev rule setting macsmc-battery charge_control thresholds), not a battery fault or firmware quirk to debug
Proposes `omarchy-battery-limit toggle` (or `on`/travel mode) as the way to get a full charge
Mentions the limit restores itself (udev rule re-applies 75/80 at boot), so travel mode lasts until reboot — no cleanup step needed
Does NOT propose editing/removing the udev rule or writing raw threshold sysfs values as the primary fix
